parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked whether an overflow in the multiplication size * nmemb could produce a length larger than data->size() and thereby cause memcpy to read beyond the string buffer. The code uses std::min(size * nmemb, data->size()), so even if size * nmemb overflows to any value, the result of std::min is guaranteed to be <= data->size(). Since memcpy copies only 'len' bytes from data->data(), it cannot read past the string's actual data. Thus no buffer overflow can occur regardless of overflow in the multiplication. Additionally, a wrap‑around overflow would reduce the product, making the copy even safer. No other checks or conditions influence this path, so the vulnerability is not present.
